scientific_limitations_integrity: The theorem is restricted to normalized Choi partial transposition and negativity for the standard isotropic spin/Landau--Streater channel. The entanglement-breaking classification \(\(j=1\)/2\) versus \(j\ge1\) is prior and is excluded from novelty; the \(j=1\) partial-transpose spectrum is also a known qutrit Werner--Holevo special case. The contribution is the uniform all-spin spectrum, exact negativity law, and negative-Pell singularity characterization. A residual risk is that equivalent all-spin partial-transpose data may be implicit in broader \(SU(2)\) recoupling literature under different terminology. The proof is analytic; finite matrix computations are supplementary checks only.
title: Exact partial-transpose spectrum and Pell singularities of isotropic spin-channel Choi states
